metrics.label: Signed horizontal heading change
metrics.formula: degrees(atan2(v0_forward*v1_lateral - v0_lateral*v1_forward, dot(v0_horizontal, v1_horizontal))); principal signed difference in [-180, 180] degrees, not unwrapped total turning; positive toward calibrated lateral axis

metrics.label: Signed lateral deviation from release heading
metrics.formula: cross_2d(unit(v0_horizontal), end_horizontal - start_horizontal); excludes vertical drop

legend.0: Poor: available evidence supports a substantial technical problem that likely reduced control.
legend.1: Mixed: some execution appears functional but there is meaningful technical instability or uncertainty.
legend.2: Solid: execution is generally controlled and the available evidence shows no major technical problem.
legend.3: Strong: available evidence clearly supports controlled, repeatable technical execution with no important correction apparent.

coaching_report.overall_assessment: This was a mixed-evidence repetition: the technique judgement leaned mixed, but there is not enough support to identify a specific fault. The curl intention is clear, though the available evidence cannot confirm whether the ball curved as intended.
coaching_report.what_went_well: The movement was captured well enough to provide a usable record of the rep. That gives a basis for comparison, even though no particular execution strength is established here.
coaching_report.primary_focus: No specific technical correction is supported; prioritize repeatability.

coaching_report.confidence_note: The technique judgement leaned mixed (85%), but insufficient evidence was strongly favored for identifying a primary issue (99%); corrective feedback was weakly warranted (7%).
